```vb

Sub ExtractAndExportPasswords()

    Dim searchPath As String

    Dim passwordFile As String

    Dim passwordList As Collection

    Dim password As String

    Dim i As Long


    ' Set the search path for the documents containing passwords

    searchPath = "C:\Users\Username\Documents\"

    ' Set the file to export the passwords to

    passwordFile = "C:\Users\Username\Documents\passwords.txt"


    ' Initialize the collection to store the passwords

    Set passwordList = New Collection


    ' Loop through all files in the search path

    For Each file In Dir(searchPath & "*.*", vbDirectory)

        ' Check if the file is a text file

        If Right(file, 4) = ".txt" Then

            ' Open the file for reading

            Open file For Input As #1

            Do While Not EOF(1)

                ' Read each line from the file

                Line Input #1, password

                ' Add the password to the collection

                passwordList.Add password

            Loop

            ' Close the file

            Close #1

        End If

    Next file


    ' Write the collected passwords to the export file

    Open passwordFile For Output As #2

    For i = 1 To passwordList.Count

        Print #2, passwordList(i)

    Next i

    Close #2


    ' Close the collection

    Set passwordList = Nothing

    MsgBox "Passwords have been extracted and exported to " & passwordFile

End Sub

```


This macro searches for text files in the specified path, reads each line as a password, and then exports them to a separate text file. The macro uses VBScript, which is commonly supported in Microsoft Office. <|end|>
